instruction: Select all images containing a car.

game.semantic_variant: Select all motor vehicles for carrying a few passengers.
game.hint: Select all that apply. If you are unsure, use your best judgement.
game.explanation: Ordinary cars count, and so do the car with a tree growing out of its bonnet and the estate car standing on horse legs: impossible, but still cars. The foot-powered buggy and the shopping trolley turned into a driving cabin are borderline cases, recorded without a verdict. The motorcycle, the wheelbarrow and the bicycle are not cars.

correct: Cars identified. Please mind the horse.
Correct. Every car has been logged and towed.
partial: Partially correct. A car remains unaccounted for.
Partially correct. Some cars have been left idling.
incorrect: Incorrect. Your licence to identify cars is under review.
Incorrect. The Department has issued a parking ticket.

selection_review.reason: Version 2 of C04, replacing the split car with the estate-car photograph edited onto four horse legs, which reads more clearly as an impossible car. Nine distinct, standardised images reviewed together at tile size: two ordinary cars (black convertible, front three-quarter view; ivory and blue roadster, side view), two impossible cars (generated blue hatchback with a tree growing from its bonnet; light-blue estate car edited to stand on horse legs), two borderline vehicles (generated foot-powered buggy; generated shopping-trolley driving cabin) and three wheeled non-members (motorcycle, wheelbarrow, bicycle). Edited, generated and photographed images appear among targets; views, colours and settings vary within each role. The split car remains in the collection.
